investigation.title: Remote Agent Provisioning: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocking All Remote-Agent Checks
investigation.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-09-21T01:03–01:04Z with an identical 502 bad-gateway error indicating the swarm gateway ELB endpoint was unreachable during agent provisioning. Because the failure occurs at POST /api/agents before any agent identity is returned, no required evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected, causing the expected-output contract to be fully unmet.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway — the AWS ELB target that the production-api proxies agent-creation requests to at /v1/agents — was unreachable at the time of the eval run. The production-api returned HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" and the message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning: error sending request for url (http://[REDACTED].elb.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/v1/agents)" for every attempt. Because agent creation is a prerequisite for all downstream remote-agent checks, all three checks failed with the same error before producing any evidence. This is an eval-observed infrastructure connectivity failure localized to the swarm gateway / ELB layer in us-east-2; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so impact to production end-users cannot be confirmed from this packet alone.

possibleCauses: Primary — Swarm gateway ELB in us-east-2 was down, misconfigured, or had no healthy targets at the time of the eval run, causing the production-api to return 502 for all POST /api/agents requests. This is the most directly supported cause given the explicit 'swarm gateway unreachable' error message and the identical failure across all three sibling checks.

Secondary — A transient network partition or DNS resolution failure between the production-api service and the ELB endpoint caused the connection to fail. The ~11.3–11.5 s latency across all three checks is consistent with a TCP connect timeout rather than an application-level error.

Quaternary — The eval runner's access token or org credentials were valid (the runner did not return a SKIP for missing token per run-status-probes.mjs line 1882), so an auth failure at the gateway is less likely but cannot be fully excluded without gateway-side logs.

investigations.rootCause: The swarm gateway — the AWS ELB target that the production-api proxies agent-creation requests to at /v1/agents — was unreachable at the time of the eval run. The production-api returned HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" and the message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning: error sending request for url (http://[REDACTED].elb.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/v1/agents)" for every attempt. Because agent creation is a prerequisite for all downstream remote-agent checks, all three checks failed with the same error before producing any evidence. This is an eval-observed infrastructure connectivity failure localized to the swarm gateway / ELB layer in us-east-2; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so impact to production end-users cannot be confirmed from this packet alone.
